description.value: A seasonal fishing and hunting resort on the shore of Loon Lake, open May long weekend through October, with tent and RV campsites, boat rentals, and deliberately no WiFi or reliable cell service. Access is via Loon Lake Rd off Hwy 97; phone reservations recommended as sites fill fast.

address.value: 2890 Loon Lake Rd, Cache Creek, BC V0K 1H1
